description: Hold npm version updates for 7 days, matching midnight-wallet, even if a preset adds a shorter npm-specific age (config:best-practices sets 3 days via security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, and a matching packageRule overrides top-level config).
matchUpdateTypes is limited to version bumps because pin, replacement, bump, lockfileUpdate, rollback and lockFileMaintenance updates have no releaseTimestamp and could never satisfy the age gate.
Do not let a missing releaseTimestamp block an update type that never has one.

minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required, so with minimumReleaseAge set these updates, including the SHA-pinned GitHub Action digest bumps this repo relies on, would stay pending forever (renovatebot/renovate#45236).

packageRules.description: changesets/action v2 only runs with @changesets/cli v3, and cd.yml uses v1 inputs; migrate both majors together by hand
